messages:
alice.m: Heads up — noticed a jump in 5xx from hosted API right after the partial deploy ~10m ago. 5m error rate up to 6% (was ~0.2%). Mostly gateway 502/504 and some 500s. Customers reporting timeouts. @dan.sre can you triage? @carla.support customer escalations piling up.

dan.sre: I'm on it. Looking at gateway logs now, seems concentrated on requests that hit billing/auth check path. Initial grep:
```
ERROR gateway: upstream=auth-check service=auth-service id=auth-32 code=500 msg="upstream error"
WARN auth-service: token exchange failed: invalid_client key_id=rot-02
```

ben.ops: Deploy bot shows a partial rollout this morning (20% traffic to new image) — commit `c9f4a2b` for api-gateway and `a71d11f` for auth-service. Traffic split configured via `traffic-split` controller to 20/80. Deploy-bot: `deploy started: api-gateway c9f4a2b -> traffic 20% us-west`.

deploy-bot: rollout: api-gateway c9f4a2b (percent: 20) | auth-service a71d11f (percent: 20) | started by erin.prod

carla.support: We're seeing a small cluster of high-touch customers who've hit repeated 5xx; raising P1 for customer-facing queue. I'm sending queued customers a note with retries suggested.

dan.sre: Hypothesis: new auth-service build expects rotated client keys (certs) and returns 403/invalid_client for legacy gateway behavior. Our gateway mapping currently maps upstream 403 to 500 for certain call paths — so clients see 5xx instead of propagated 403. Also timing: key rotation finished but some upstream pods still using old key cache; combined with the 20% traffic shift it's hitting the broken path.

alice.m: Any quick mitigations? If we revert traffic split to previous or pin routing to old auth-service, we can stop hit.

ben.ops: I can patch traffic split to 0/100 in 2m. Command I ran: `kubectl -n prod patch configmap traffic-split -p '{"data":{"api-gateway":"0,100"}}'` (using local controller). Rolling that now.

erin.prod: Hold on — we also had a billing entitlement change in the same deploy (billing-service validation tightened). Combined effect might be some requests failing entitlement check then auth path tries to interpret as internal error. Logs: `billing: entitlement missing -> 403` then `gateway: billing-check failed -> mapped to 500 due to legacy mapper`.

carla.support: Customers asking if there's a workaround: recommend exponential retry and 429/5xx handling at client. I've opened refunds/escalation for top 3 customers impacted.

dan.sre: After patching traffic split back to 0/100, I'm seeing error rate dropping in metrics dashboard. Rolling back auth-service in parallel: `kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/auth-service --to-revision=14` (undoing to the prior revision).

ben.ops: Rollback started for auth-service. `kubectl rollout status deployment/auth-service -n prod` shows new pods terminating and old ones coming up.

(alarm) incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-142 created — automatic alert for 5xx spike. Assigned: dan.sre, ben.ops.

dan.sre: Quick repro steps for debugging locally: 1) `curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <rotated-token>\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` 2) Observe auth-service token-exchange log: `invalid_client key_id=rot-02` 3) Confirm gateway mapping: `kubectl -n prod get configmap gateway-mapper -o yaml` and inspect `status_code_map` for billing->500 entries.

alice.m: Any config fixes we can hotpatch to avoid mapping 403 -> 500 while we sort keys?

dan.sre: Yes — patch `gateway-mapper` to map billing 403 to 403 and not translate to 500 for `/v1/generate` path. Patch applied: `kubectl -n prod patch configmap gateway-mapper --patch '{"data":{"status_map":"billing:403=403"}}'`. Monitoring.

ben.ops: Metrics showing 5xx back to baseline in the last 8m. Error counts: 5xx dropped from ~600/min to ~12/min, gateway 502s gone.

carla.support: Notifying affected customers: outbound note sent to top 5 with mitigation steps and ETA for full root cause follow-up.

erin.prod: Raising follow-up: we'll add canary checks for auth key compatibility and a preflight for billing entitlement responses. Also block entitlements tightening from shipping without integration test.

alice.m: Thanks everyone. Postmortem request from support and SRE will be needed. Please add timeline entries (deploy-bot logs, traffic-split changes, rollback times).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-142 status: resolved — 5xx spike mitigated after traffic split rollback and gateway mapping patch. Incident closed at ts=1893460389.

ben.ops: I'll follow up with a brief runbook item to avoid mapping 4xx->5xx in future and to ensure key rotations are synchronized with traffic-shift windows.

carla.support: Filing customer impact report and refund recommendations now.

alice.m: Great work. We'll do a postmortem doc and add tests to CI for auth+billing integration before next partial rollout. :thumbsup:
